    header = (b"hia-asm.v1 hepta.hia.program.v8 selfhost\n"
        b"fn f0(v0:readbuf,v1:mutbuf,v2:mutbuf) -> (u32) effects(read,write,trap) entry(b0)\n"
        b"block b0(v0:readbuf,v1:mutbuf,v2:mutbuf)\n")
    invalid = {
        "unknown-opcode": sample.replace(b"int.mul.wrap", b"int.bad.wrap", 1),
        "missing-end": sample.rsplit(b"end\n", 1)[0],
        "overflow-u64": sample.replace(b'{"value":5381}', b'{"value":18446744073709551616}', 1),
        "overflow-u32": sample.replace(b'{"value":5381}', b'{"value":4294967296}', 1),
        "duplicate-ssa": sample.replace(b"v20:u32 = call", b"v17:u32 = call", 1),
        "out-of-scope": sample.replace(b"call(v17,v19)", b"call(v10,v19)", 1),
        "absent-block": sample.replace(b"jump b1(", b"jump b99(", 1),
        "edge-type": sample.replace(b"b1(v0,v1,v2,v3,v4,v5)", b"b1(v0,v1,v2,v3,v3,v5)", 1),
        "call-type": sample.replace(b"call(v17,v19)", b"call(v19,v17)", 1),
        "recursive-call-signature": sample.replace(b'{"function":"f1"}', b'{"function":"f0"}', 1),
        "mutable-alias": sample.replace(b"b1(v0,v1,v2,v3,v4,v5)", b"b1(v0,v1,v1,v3,v4,v5)", 1),
        "readonly-jump-alias": header + b"  jump b1(v0,v0)\nblock b1(v3:readbuf,v4:readbuf)\n"
            b'  v5:u32 = const() {"value":0}\n  ret(v5)\nend\n',
        "readonly-branch-alias": header + b'  v3:bool = const() {"value":false}\n'
            b"  branch v3 b1(v0,v0) b2()\nblock b1(v4:readbuf,v5:readbuf)\n"
            b'  v6:u32 = const() {"value":0}\n  ret(v6)\nblock b2()\n'
            b'  v7:u32 = const() {"value":0}\n  ret(v7)\nend\n',
        "readonly-write": sample.replace(b"  v20:u32 = call", b"  _ = buffer.store(v13,v16,v19)\n  v20:u32 = call", 1),
        "unreachable-block": sample.replace(b"end\nfn f1", extra + b"end\nfn f1", 1),
        "duplicate-function": sample.replace(b"fn f1(", b"fn f0(", 1),
        "quoted-declaration": sample.replace(b"fn f1(", b'fn "f1"(', 1),
        "unquoted-call": sample.replace(b'{"function":"f1"}', b'{"function":f1}', 1),
        "leading-zero": sample.replace(b'{"value":5381}', b'{"value":05381}', 1),
        "invalid-byte": sample + b"\x00",
        "empty-source": b"",
    }
    # These are required boundaries in the existing hia-asm.v1 regex grammar,
    # not just a preference for the renderer's whitespace spelling.
    spacing = {
        "function-adjacency": (b"fn f0(", b"fn f0 ("),
        "block-adjacency": (b"block b0(", b"block b0 ("),
        "effects-adjacency": (b"effects(", b"effects ("),
        "entry-adjacency": (b"entry(b0)", b"entry (b0)"),
        "entry-open-adjacency": (b"entry(b0)", b"entry( b0)"),
        "entry-close-adjacency": (b"entry(b0)", b"entry(b0 )"),
        "arrow-adjacency": (b"->", b"- >"),
        "return-adjacency": (b"ret(v25)", b"ret (v25)"),
        "edge-adjacency": (b"jump b1(", b"jump b1 ("),
        "branch-separation": (b") b3(v7,v8,v10)", b")b3(v7,v8,v10)"),
        "opcode-adjacency": (b"buffer.len(v0)", b"buffer.len (v0)"),
        "constant-attribute-separation": (b"const() {", b"const(){"),
        "call-attribute-separation": (b"call(v17,v19) {", b"call(v17,v19){"),
        "cast-attribute-separation": (b"int.cast(v25) {", b"int.cast(v25){"),
        "effects-separation": (b"(u32) effects", b"(u32)effects"),
        "entry-separation": (b"trap) entry", b"trap)entry"),
    }
    for name, (old, new) in spacing.items():
        assert old in sample, name
        invalid[name] = sample.replace(old, new, 1)
    return invalid


def independent_call_reference(sample):
    """Record the general Core's distinct acceptance and scalar-execution view.

    Called before B0. The non-tail/mutual fixtures are legal general Core but
    refused by this native profile; never label that as Core invalidity.
    """
    from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import assemble_program
    from hepta.hia_program import HIAProgramRejected, execute_program
    backward = assemble_program(backward_bytesum_source(sample))
    chain = assemble_program(backward_chain_source())
    observations = []
    for left, right in ((0, 0), (5381, 255), (0xffffffff, 1), (0x80000000, 128)):
        observation = execute_program(backward, "f2", [left, right])
        assert observation["result"] == ((left * 33) ^ right) & 0xffffffff
        observations.append(observation)
    observation = execute_program(chain, "f127", [1], max_call_depth=128)
    assert observation["result"] == 127
    observations.append(observation)
    refusals = []
    for label, source in call_graph_invalid_sources(sample).items():
        try:
            assemble_program(source)
        except HIAProgramRejected as exc:
            refusals.append({"case": label, "source_sha256": digest(source),
                             "general_core": "rejected", "code": exc.code})
        else:
            raise AssertionError("invalid call source passed general Core: " + label)
    for label, source in recursion_refusals().items():
        checked = assemble_program(source)
        refusals.append({"case": label, "source_sha256": digest(source),
                         "general_core": "accepted", "core_sha256": checked.sha256,
                         "selfhost_profile_expected": "rejected: acyclic call graph required"})
    return {"general_core_observations": observations, "admission_differences": refusals}


def inspect_selfhost_object(data):
    """Read-only independent inspection; never constructs or repairs an object."""
    if len(data) < 64:
        raise ValueError("truncated HIA ELF object")
    header = struct.unpack_from("<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH", data)
    ident, kind, machine, version, entry, phoff, shoff, flags, ehsize, phsize, phnum, shsize, shnum, names_index = header
    if (ident != b"\x7fELF\x02\x01\x01\x00" + b"\0" * 8
            or (kind, machine, version, entry, phoff, flags, ehsize, phsize, phnum, shsize, shnum, names_index)
            != (1, 62, 1, 0, 0, 0, 64, 0, 0, 64, 6, 4)
            or shoff % 8 or shoff + 6 * 64 != len(data)):
        raise ValueError("ELF header is outside the closed HIA ET_REL profile")
    sections = [struct.unpack_from("<IIQQQQIIQQ", data, shoff + i * 64) for i in range(6)]
    if any(sections[0]):
        raise ValueError("non-null ELF null section")
    for row in sections[1:]:
        if row[3] != 0 or row[4] < 64 or row[4] + row[5] > shoff:
            raise ValueError("ELF section outside the object payload")
    names = data[sections[4][4]:sections[4][4] + sections[4][5]]
    expected_names = b"\0.text\0.symtab\0.strtab\0.shstrtab\0.note.GNU-stack\0"
    if names != expected_names or [row[0] for row in sections] != [0, 1, 7, 15, 23, 33]:
        raise ValueError("ELF section-name inventory differs")
    text, sym, strings, shstrings, stack = sections[1:]
    if ((text[1], text[2], text[4], text[6], text[7], text[8], text[9]) != (1, 6, 64, 0, 0, 16, 0)
            or (sym[1], sym[2], sym[5], sym[6], sym[7], sym[8], sym[9]) != (2, 0, 72, 3, 2, 8, 24)
            or (strings[1], strings[2], strings[5], strings[6], strings[7], strings[8], strings[9]) != (3, 0, 4, 0, 0, 1, 0)
            or (shstrings[1], shstrings[2], shstrings[5], shstrings[6], shstrings[7], shstrings[8], shstrings[9]) != (3, 0, 49, 0, 0, 1, 0)
            or (stack[1], stack[2], stack[5], stack[6], stack[7], stack[8], stack[9]) != (1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0)):
        raise ValueError("ELF section flags or links differ")
    if (sym[4] != ((64 + text[5] + 7) & ~7) or strings[4] != sym[4] + 72
            or shstrings[4] != strings[4] + 4 or stack[4] != shstrings[4] + 49):
        raise ValueError("ELF payload layout differs")
    symbols = [struct.unpack_from("<IBBHQQ", data, sym[4] + i * 24) for i in range(3)]
    if (any(symbols[0]) or symbols[1] != (0, 3, 0, 1, 0, 0)
            or symbols[2][:5] != (1, 18, 0, 1, 0) or not 0 < symbols[2][5] <= text[5]
            or data[strings[4]:strings[4] + 4] != b"\0f0\0"):
        raise ValueError("ELF symbol inventory differs")
    return {"format": "ELF64-ET_REL", "machine": "EM_X86_64", "exports": ["f0"],
            "undefined_symbols": [], "external_relocations": [], "nonexecuting_stack_note": True,
            "text_offset": 64, "text_bytes": text[5], "text_sha256": digest(data[64:64 + text[5]]),
            "entry_wrapper_bytes": symbols[2][5], "object_sha256": digest(data)}


def observe_native_tool(directory, label, tool_name, arguments):
    path = shutil.which(tool_name)
    if path is None:
        raise RuntimeError("ELF qualification requires " + tool_name)
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    before = digest(path.read_bytes())
    command = [str(path), *map(str, arguments)]
    started = time.monotonic_ns()
    completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, timeout=20)
    (directory / (label + ".stdout.log")).write_bytes(completed.stdout)
    (directory / (label + ".stderr.log")).write_bytes(completed.stderr)
    receipt = {"command": command, "tool_sha256": before, "returncode": completed.returncode,
               "stdout_sha256": digest(completed.stdout), "stderr_sha256": digest(completed.stderr),
               "wall_elapsed_ns": time.monotonic_ns() - started}
    (directory / (label + ".command.json")).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    if digest(path.read_bytes()) != before or completed.returncode:
        raise AssertionError({"native_tool_failed": label, "receipt": receipt})
    return receipt


def qualify_elf_outputs(directory, compilers, sample, checks):
    observations = []
    def object_source(source):
        return source.replace(b"hepta.hia.program.v8 selfhost\n",
                              b"hepta.hia.program.v8 selfhost_elf\n", 1)
    for label, compiler, own_source in compilers:
        for subject, source, flat in (("compiler", own_source, compiler),
                                     ("bytesum", sample, directory / (label + "-bytesum.image.bin"))):
            case = label + "-elf-" + subject
            obj, compilation = compile_stage(directory, case, compiler, object_source(source), output_extension=".o")
            inventory = inspect_selfhost_object(obj.read_bytes())
            checks[case + "_text_matches_flat"] = inventory["text_sha256"] == digest(flat.read_bytes())
            tools = [observe_native_tool(directory, case + "-readelf", "readelf", ["-W", "-h", "-S", "-s", "-r", obj]),
                     observe_native_tool(directory, case + "-objdump", "objdump", ["-d", "--disassemble=f0", obj])]
            linked = directory / (case + ".so")
            tools.append(observe_native_tool(directory, case + "-link", "ld",
                ["-m", "elf_x86_64", "-shared", "-z", "defs", "-z", "noexecstack",
                 "-z", "relro", "-z", "now", "--build-id=none", obj, "-o", linked]))
            checks[case + "_independent_tools_accept"] = all(row["returncode"] == 0 for row in tools)
            observations.append({"case": case, "compilation": compilation, "inventory": inventory,
                                 "tool_observations": tools, "linked_sha256": digest(linked.read_bytes())})
            if subject == "compiler":
                rebuilt, result = compile_stage(directory, case + "-rebuild", linked, own_source,
                                                 image_format="linked-selfhost")
                checks[case + "_linked_self_rebuild"] = rebuilt.read_bytes() == flat.read_bytes()
                observations.append(result)
            else:
                for index, data in enumerate((b"", bytes(range(256)) * 4)):
                    result, output = invoke(directory, case + "-run-" + str(index), linked, data,
                                            image_format="linked-selfhost", capacity=1, workspace_size=1)
                    checks[case + "_behavior_" + str(index)] = (result.get("status") == "returned"
                        and result.get("core_u32") == hash_reference(data) and result.get("source_unchanged")
                        and output == bytes([hash_reference(data) & 255]))
                    observations.append(result)
            result, _ = invoke(directory, case + "-short-output", compiler, object_source(source),
                               capacity=compilation["produced_bytes"] - 1)
            checks[case + "_short_output_transactional"] = (result.get("status") == "returned"
                and result.get("core_u32") == NO_SPACE and result.get("output_unchanged"))
            observations.append(result)
        rejected = {"bad-call": call_graph_invalid_sources(sample)["backward-signature"],
                    "recursive": recursion_refusals()["mutual-recursion"]}
        for name, bad in rejected.items():
            result, _ = invoke(directory, label + "-elf-reject-" + name, compiler, object_source(bad))
            checks[label + "_elf_reject_" + name] = (result.get("status") == "returned"
                and result.get("core_u32") == INVALID and result.get("output_unchanged")
                and result.get("source_unchanged"))
            observations.append(result)
    return observations


def _phase_manifest_digest(manifest):
    return digest(json.dumps(manifest, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode())


def _phase_inputs(directory, family, compiler, label):
    paths = {"native_observer": directory / "native-observer.elf",
             "linked_observer": directory / "linked-observer.elf",
             "compiler": compiler, "source": SOURCE, "sample": SAMPLE,
             "modified_source": directory / "modified-selfhost.hepta"}
    if family in PHASE_REFERENCE_FILES:
        paths["reference"] = directory / PHASE_REFERENCE_FILES[family]
    if family == "elf":
        paths["sample_image"] = directory / (label + "-bytesum.image.bin")
    return {name: {"path": str(Path(path).resolve()), "sha256": digest(Path(path).read_bytes())}
            for name, path in paths.items()}


def _read_phase_inputs(inputs):
    result = {}
    for name, identity in inputs.items():
        data = Path(identity["path"]).read_bytes()
        if digest(data) != identity["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("qualification phase input changed: " + name)
        result[name] = data
    return result


def qualification_phase(request_path):
    """Run one closed family in a fresh host-oracle process, never a successor."""
    request = json.loads(Path(request_path).read_text())
    if (set(request) != {"schema", "family", "compiler_label", "directory", "inputs", "source_manifest_sha256"}
            or request["schema"] != "hepta.hia.selfhost-phase-request.v1"
            or request["family"] not in QUALIFICATION_FAMILIES
            or request["compiler_label"] not in {"original", "modified"}):
        raise ValueError("unknown qualification phase request")
    family, label = request["family"], request["compiler_label"]
    expected_inputs = {"native_observer", "linked_observer", "compiler", "source", "sample", "modified_source"}
    if family in PHASE_REFERENCE_FILES:
        expected_inputs.add("reference")
    if family == "elf":
        expected_inputs.add("sample_image")
    if set(request["inputs"]) != expected_inputs:
        raise ValueError("qualification phase input inventory differs")
    validate_contract()
    before = source_manifest()
    if _phase_manifest_digest(before) != request["source_manifest_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("qualification phase source identity differs")
    data = _read_phase_inputs(request["inputs"])
    directory = Path(request["directory"])
    compiler = Path(request["inputs"]["compiler"]["path"])
    # This is a content-bound, freshly HIA-emitted adapter, not a cached child.
    # The module imported by family helpers must share this explicit binding.
    import tools.qualify_hia_selfhost as runtime
    runtime.NATIVE_OBSERVER = Path(request['inputs']['native_observer']['path'])
    runtime.NATIVE_LINKED_OBSERVER = Path(request['inputs']['linked_observer']['path'])
    global NATIVE_OBSERVER, NATIVE_LINKED_OBSERVER
    NATIVE_OBSERVER = runtime.NATIVE_OBSERVER
    NATIVE_LINKED_OBSERVER = runtime.NATIVE_LINKED_OBSERVER
    compilers = ((label, compiler),)
    reference = json.loads(data["reference"]) if "reference" in data else None
    checks = {}
    started = time.monotonic_ns()
    if family == "elf":
        source = data["source"] if label == "original" else data["modified_source"]
        # This is the pinned bytesum artifact produced earlier by this same
        # fresh generation chain, transported into this worker's own directory.
        (directory / (label + "-bytesum.image.bin")).write_bytes(data["sample_image"])
        observations = qualify_elf_outputs(directory, ((label, compiler, source),), data["sample"], checks)
    elif family == "exports":
        from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost_exports import qualify as qualify_exports
        observations = qualify_exports(directory, compiler, checks, reference, label)
    elif family == "names":
        from tools.hia_selfhost_names import qualify as qualify_names
        observations = qualify_names(directory, compiler, checks, reference, label)
    elif family == "cli":
        from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost_cli import qualify as qualify_cli
        source = data["source"] if label == "original" else data["modified_source"]
        observations = qualify_cli(directory, compiler, source, checks, reference, label)
    elif family == "resource":
        from tools.hia_selfhost_resources import qualify_resources
        observations = qualify_resources(directory, compilers, checks, reference)
    elif family == "bulk":
        from tools.hia_selfhost_bulk import qualify_bulk
        observations = qualify_bulk(directory, compilers, checks, reference)
    elif family == "loan":
        from tools.hia_selfhost_loans import qualify_loans
        observations = qualify_loans(directory, compilers, checks, reference)
    elif family == "cfg":
        from tools.hia_selfhost_cfg_worklist import qualify as qualify_cfg
        observations = qualify_cfg(directory, compilers, checks, reference)
    elif family == "effects":
        from tools.hia_selfhost_effects import qualify as qualify_effects
        observations = qualify_effects(directory, compilers, checks, reference)
    elif family == "multi":
        from tools.hia_selfhost_multi_results import qualify as qualify_multi
        observations = qualify_multi(directory, compilers, checks, reference)
    elif family == "explicit-traps":
        from tools.hia_selfhost_traps import qualify as qualify_traps
        observations = qualify_traps(directory, compilers, checks, reference)
    elif family == "signed":
        from tools.hia_selfhost_signed_cases import qualify as qualify_signed
        observations = qualify_signed(directory, compilers, checks, reference)
    elif family == "scalar-casts":
        from tools.hia_selfhost_scalar_casts import qualify as qualify_casts
        observations = qualify_casts(directory, compilers, checks, reference)
    elif family == "keyword":
        from tools.hia_selfhost_keywords import qualify as qualify_keyword
        observations = qualify_keyword(directory, compilers, checks, reference)
    elif family == "owned":
        from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost_owned_elf import qualify as qualify_owned_elf
        owned = qualify_owned_elf(directory / (label + "-owned-elf"), compiler)
        checks[label + "_owned_elf_report_pass"] = owned["status"] == "PASS_SCOPED_OWNED_BUFFER_ELF"
        for row in owned["cases"]:
            checks[label + "_owned_elf_" + row["case"]["id"]] = row["pass"]
        for row in owned["refusals"]:
            checks[label + "_owned_elf_reject_" + row["name"]] = row["pass"]
        observations = [{"compiler": label, "report": owned}]
    elif family == "chain":
        from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost_chain_elf import qualify as qualify_chain_elf
        from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost_chain_flow import qualify as qualify_chain_allocator
        chain = qualify_chain_elf(directory / (label + "-chain-elf"), compiler)
        checks[label + "_chain_elf_report_pass"] = chain["status"] == "PASS_SCOPED_CHAIN_ELF"
        for row in chain["cases"]:
            checks[label + "_chain_elf_" + row["case"]["id"]] = row["pass"]
        for row in chain["refusals"]:
            checks[label + "_chain_elf_reject_" + row["name"]] = row["pass"]
        allocator = qualify_chain_allocator(directory / (label + "-chain-allocator"), compiler)
        checks[label + "_chain_allocator_report_pass"] = (allocator["status"] == "PASS_SCOPED_CHAIN_ALLOCATOR_CONTRACT"
            and allocator["source_files_unchanged"])
        for row in allocator["cases"]:
            checks[label + "_chain_allocator_" + row["case"]["id"]] = row["pass"]
        observations = {"chain": [{"compiler": label, "report": chain}],
                        "allocator": [{"compiler": label, "report": allocator}]}
    elif family == "capacity":
        from tools.hia_selfhost_capacity import qualify_capacity
        observations = qualify_capacity(directory, compilers, checks, reference)
    elif family == "tail":
        from tools.hia_selfhost_tailcalls import qualify_tailcalls
        observations = qualify_tailcalls(directory, compilers, checks, reference)
    else:
        from tools.hia_selfhost_select import qualify_select
        observations = qualify_select(directory, compilers, checks, reference)
    _read_phase_inputs(request["inputs"])
    if source_manifest() != before:
        raise ValueError("qualification phase source changed")
    return {"schema": "hepta.hia.selfhost-phase.v1", "family": family, "compiler_label": label,
            "source_manifest_sha256": request["source_manifest_sha256"],
            "input_sha256": {key: value["sha256"] for key, value in request["inputs"].items()},
            "checks": checks, "observations": observations,
            "status": "PASS" if all(checks.values()) else "FAIL",
            "elapsed_ns": time.monotonic_ns() - started,
            "worker_pid": os.getpid(),
            "python": {"isolated": bool(sys.flags.isolated), "no_site": bool(sys.flags.no_site),
                       "dont_write_bytecode": bool(sys.flags.dont_write_bytecode)},
            "fresh_host_oracle_process": True, "successor_process_reuse": False}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _PendingPhaseArchive:
    future: object


class _PhaseArchivePool:
    """One archiver, at most two unsealed completed phases, no native calls.

    Holding an oracle slot while archiving a stopped child unnecessarily
    serializes native work behind filesystem/compression work. The separate
    bounded lane retains every byte and all seal/replay checks. Its queue can
    add at most two phase directories to the two currently executing phases;
    a phase is not completed in the index until its archive succeeds.
    """
    def __init__(self):
        self._slots = BoundedSemaphore(2)
        self._pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1, thread_name_prefix="hia-stage-archive")

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exception):
        self._pool.shutdown(wait=True)

    def submit(self, function, *arguments):
        self._slots.acquire()
        try:
            future = self._pool.submit(function, *arguments)
        except BaseException:
            self._slots.release()
            raise
        future.add_done_callback(lambda completed: self._slots.release())
        return _PendingPhaseArchive(future)


def _seal_qualification_phase(phase_directory, archive_token, receipt_path, report, receipt):
    from tools.hia_evidence_archive import archive_completed_stage
    receipt["raw_artifacts"] = archive_completed_stage(phase_directory, archive_token)
    receipt["archive_completed_monotonic_ns"] = time.monotonic_ns()
    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return report, receipt


def _run_qualification_phase(directory, family, label, compiler, manifest_digest, archives=None):
    stem = "phase-" + family + "-" + label
    phase_directory = directory / "phase-runs" / (family + "-" + label)
    phase_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False, mode=0o700)
    # Only this newly constructed stage may be losslessly packed after its
    # direct worker exits. Existing/frozen evidence is never swept or mutated.
    import secrets
    from tools.hia_evidence_archive import OWNER
    archive_token = secrets.token_hex(32)
    (phase_directory / OWNER).write_text(archive_token)
    request = {"schema": "hepta.hia.selfhost-phase-request.v1", "family": family,
               "compiler_label": label, "directory": str(phase_directory),
               "inputs": _phase_inputs(directory, family, compiler, label),
               "source_manifest_sha256": manifest_digest}
    request_path, report_path = directory / (stem + ".request.json"), directory / (stem + ".json")
    request_path.write_text(json.dumps(request, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    command = [sys.executable, "-I", "-S", "-B", str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
               "--phase-request", str(request_path), "--output", str(report_path)]
    started = time.monotonic_ns()
    with (directory / (stem + ".stdout.log")).open("wb") as stdout, (directory / (stem + ".stderr.log")).open("wb") as stderr:
        # At most two host-oracle workers run concurrently. Their native calls
        # remain individual resource-limited children. Flat and linked HIA ABI
        # calls exec sealed HIA-emitted observers without a Python child runtime;

    if archives is not None:

def _merge_qualification_phases(results, checks):
    expected = {(family, label) for family in QUALIFICATION_FAMILIES for label in ("original", "modified")}
    if len(results) != len(expected):
        raise AssertionError("incomplete qualification phase inventory")
    phases, pending_checks = {}, {}
    for report, receipt in results:
        key = report["family"], report["compiler_label"]
        if key not in expected or key in phases or type(report.get("checks")) is not dict or not report["checks"]:
            raise AssertionError("duplicate, unknown or empty qualification phase")
        if any(type(value) is not bool for value in report["checks"].values()):
            raise AssertionError("qualification phase checks must be booleans")
        if report.get("status") != ("PASS" if all(report["checks"].values()) else "FAIL"):
            raise AssertionError("qualification phase status differs from checks")
        if set(report["checks"]) & (set(checks) | set(pending_checks)):
            raise AssertionError("qualification phase would overwrite an existing check")
        pending_checks.update(report["checks"])
        phases[key] = (report, receipt)
    checks.update(pending_checks)
    return phases


def _collect_qualification_phases(directory, scheduled):
    """Observe every future, retaining all failures before refusing the batch."""
    index_path = directory / "phase-index.json"
    entries = [{"family": family, "compiler_label": label, "state": "pending",
                "request": str(directory / ("phase-" + family + "-" + label + ".request.json")),
                "report": str(directory / ("phase-" + family + "-" + label + ".json")),
                "process_receipt": str(directory / ("phase-" + family + "-" + label + ".process.json"))}
               for family, label, _ in scheduled]
    order = {future: position for position, (_, _, future) in enumerate(scheduled)}
    observed = set(order)
    results, failures, control_exceptions = {}, [], []

    def retain():
        value = {"schema": "hepta.hia.selfhost-phase-index.v1", "phases": entries,
                 "completed": sum(row["state"] != "pending" for row in entries),
                 "exceptions": len(failures)}
        temporary = index_path.with_suffix(".json.tmp")
        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
        temporary.replace(index_path)

    retain()
    while order:
        done, _ = wait(order, return_when=FIRST_COMPLETED)
        for future in done:
            position = order.pop(future)
            entry = entries[position]
            try:
                result = future.result()
                if type(result) is _PendingPhaseArchive:
                    if result.future in observed:
                        raise AssertionError("qualification archive future reused")
                    observed.add(result.future)
                    order[result.future] = position
                    # The actual native work has ended, but raw evidence is
                    # not sealed yet. Keep the same pending index entry.
                    continue
            except BaseException as error:
                # Worker/seal exceptions are data until all known futures
                # have been observed. Control exceptions remain exceptions.
                entry.update(state="exception", exception_type=type(error).__module__ + "." + type(error).__qualname__,
                             exception_message=str(error))
                failures.append(entry.copy())
                if not isinstance(error, Exception):
                    control_exceptions.append(error)
            else:
                results[position] = result
                entry.update(state="completed", report_status=result[0].get("status"))
            retain()
    if control_exceptions:
        raise control_exceptions[0]
    if failures:
        raise AssertionError({"qualification_phase_exceptions": failures, "phase_index": str(index_path)})
    return [results[position] for position in range(len(scheduled))]

        add(0x15, number, 'kill', 0)
    add(0x15, 9, 'protection', 0)
    add(0x15, 10, 'protection', 0)
    add(0x05, 'allow')
    label('protection')
    add(0x20, 32)  # args[2], mmap/mprotect protection
    add(0x54, 6)
    add(0x15, 6, 'kill', 'allow')
    label('kill')
    add(0x06, 0x80000000)
    label('allow')
    add(0x06, 0x7fff0000)
    values = []
    for index, (code, k, jt, jf) in enumerate(instructions):
        def offset(value):
            result = labels[value] - index - 1 if isinstance(value, str) else value
            assert 0 <= result <= 255
            return result
        values.append(Filter(code, offset(jt), offset(jf),
                             labels[k] - index - 1 if isinstance(k, str) else k))
    filters = (Filter * len(values))(*values)
    program = Program(len(values), filters)
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    def install():
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE, (0, 0))
        if libc.prctl(38, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0:
            raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS')
        if libc.prctl(22, 2, ctypes.byref(program), 0, 0) != 0:
            raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'PR_SET_SECCOMP')
    return install


def bundle(files):
    result = bytearray(struct.pack('<3Q', BUNDLE_MAGIC, len(files), 0))
    for name, mode, data in files:
        name = name.encode('ascii') if isinstance(name, str) else name
        result += struct.pack('<3Q', len(name), mode, len(data)) + name + data
    return bytes(result)


def unpack(raw):
    """An independent HIAREL01 output oracle, never part of the native runtime."""
    import io
    stream = io.BytesIO(raw)
    header = stream.read(24)
    if len(raw) > WIRE_LIMIT or len(header) != 24:
        raise ValueError('wire extent')
    magic, count, reserved = struct.unpack('<3Q', header)
    if magic != BUNDLE_MAGIC or reserved or not 1 <= count <= 256:
        raise ValueError('header')
    result = {}
    for _ in range(count):
        fields = stream.read(24)
        if len(fields) != 24:
            raise ValueError('entry header')
        n, mode, size = struct.unpack('<3Q', fields)
        if not 1 <= n <= 127 or mode != 0o400 or not 1 <= size <= IMAGE_LIMIT:
            raise ValueError('entry limits')
        name = stream.read(n)
        if len(name) != n or re.fullmatch(rb'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*', name) is None or name in result:
            raise ValueError('name')
        data = stream.read(size)
        if len(data) != size:
            raise ValueError('payload')
        result[name] = data
    if stream.read():
        raise ValueError('trailing bytes')
    return result


def expected_elf(images):
    prefix, holes = template()
    policy, compiler, packer = images
    result = bytearray(prefix + policy + compiler + packer)
    struct.pack_into('<Q', result, 96, len(result))
    struct.pack_into('<Q', result, 104, len(result))
    for name, at in holes.items():
        offset = len(prefix)
        if name in ('compiler_hole', 'packer_hole'):
            offset += len(policy)
        if name == 'packer_hole':
            offset += len(compiler)
        struct.pack_into('<i', result, at, offset - at - 4)
    return bytes(result)


def workspace(**words):
    raw = bytearray(IMAGE_AT + 1)
    for name, value in words.items():
        struct.pack_into('<Q', raw, int(name[1:]), value)
    return raw


def observe_policy(wire, work, *, output=b'', output_size=64, offsets=(), work_offsets=()):
    body, owners, views = Body(0), [], []
    for data, extent in ((wire, len(wire)), (output, output_size), (work, POLICY_WORK_BYTES)):
        owner = body.value('buffer', 'buffer.new', [body.const('usize', extent)])
        owners.append(owner)
        view = body.value('mutbuf', 'borrow.mut', [owner])
        for at, value in enumerate(data):
            if value:
                body.effect('buffer.store', [view, body.const('usize', at), body.const('u8', value)])
        if not views:
            body.effect('loan.end', [view])
            view = body.value('readbuf', 'borrow.read', [owner])
        views.append(view)
    status = body.value('u32', 'call', views, {'function': 'f0'})
    values = [body.value('u8', 'buffer.load', [views[1], body.const('usize', at)]) for at in offsets]
    values += [body.value('u8', 'buffer.load', [views[2], body.const('usize', at)]) for at in work_offsets]
    for view in views:
        body.effect('loan.end', [view])
    for owner in owners:
        body.effect('owner.drop', [owner])
    wrapper = ('hia-asm.v1 hepta.hia.program.v8 source_build_reference\n'
               'fn observe() -> (' + ','.join(['u32'] + ['u8'] * len(values)) +
               ') effects(alloc,read,write,trap) entry(b0)\nblock b0()\n' + body.text() +
               '  ret(' + ','.join([status, *values]) + ')\nend\n' + POLICY.read_text().split('\n', 1)[1])
    actual = execute_program(assemble_program(wrapper), 'observe', [], max_steps=4000000)
    assert actual['status'] == 'returned', actual
    return actual['values'][0], bytes(actual['values'][1:])


def vm_packer():
    images = (b'\xc3', b'\x90\xc3', b'\x90\x90\xc3')
    wire = struct.pack('<4Q', PACK_MAGIC, *map(len, images)) + b''.join(images)
    expected = expected_elf(images)
    b, owners, views = Body(0), [], []
    for data, extent in ((wire, len(wire)), (b'', len(expected)), (b'', 1), (expected, len(expected))):
        owner = b.value('buffer', 'buffer.new', [b.const('usize', extent)])
        owners.append(owner)
        view = b.value('mutbuf', 'borrow.mut', [owner])
        for at, value in enumerate(data):
            if value:
                b.effect('buffer.store', [view, b.const('usize', at), b.const('u8', value)])
        if len(views) in (0, 3):
            b.effect('loan.end', [view])
            view = b.value('readbuf', 'borrow.read', [owner])
        views.append(view)
    size = b.value('u32', 'call', views[:3], {'function': 'f0'})
    difference = b.value('u8', 'call', [views[1], views[3]], {'function': 'compare_all'})
    for view in views:
        b.effect('loan.end', [view])
    for owner in owners:
        b.effect('owner.drop', [owner])
    compare = '''def compare(o:mutbuf, s:readbuf) -> u8:
    i = 0
    difference = 0
    while i < length(s):
        difference = difference | (byte(o, i) ^ byte(s, i))
        i = i + 1
    return difference
'''
    compare = render_assembly(document(compare, 'comparison')).split('\n', 1)[1].replace('fn f0(', 'fn compare_all(')
    source = ('hia-asm.v1 hepta.hia.program.v8 source_packer_reference\n'
              'fn observe() -> (u32,u8) effects(alloc,read,write,trap) entry(b0)\nblock b0()\n' +
              b.text() + '  ret(' + size + ',' + difference + ')\nend\n' + compare + PACKER.read_text().split('\n', 1)[1])
    actual = execute_program(assemble_program(source), 'observe', [], max_steps=4000000)
    assert actual['status'] == 'returned' and actual['values'] == [len(expected), 0], actual

            observed.append(fd)

            self.assertEqual(os.pread(fd, len(code) + 1, 0), code)
            self.assertEqual(kwargs['pass_fds'], (fd,))
            for mutation in (lambda: os.write(fd, b'!'),
                             lambda: os.ftruncate(fd, len(code) + 1),
                             lambda: os.ftruncate(fd, len(code) - 1),
                             lambda: fcntl.fcntl(fd, 1033, 0x0010)):
                with self.assertRaises(OSError) as caught:
                    mutation()

            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, b'checked', b'')

        # real kernel syscall function. This also exercises newer Python hosts.
        without_constants = SimpleNamespace(fcntl=fcntl.fcntl)
        with patch.object(native, '_validated_code', return_value=code), \
             patch.object(native, 'fcntl', without_constants), \

        self.assert_closed(observed[0])

        import hepta.artifact_publication_native as native
        create = os.memfd_create
        descriptors = []

        def without_sealing(name, flags):
            # A real nonsealable memfd has F_SEAL_SEAL set from creation, so
            # the kernel itself refuses the subsequent ADD_SEALS operation.
            fd = create(name, flags & ~os.MFD_ALLOW_SEALING)
            descriptors.append(fd)
            self.assertEqual(fcntl.fcntl(fd, 1034), 1)
            return fd

        with patch.object(native, '_validated_code', return_value=b'admitted'), \
             patch.object(native.os, 'memfd_create', side_effect=without_sealing), \
             patch.object(native.subprocess, 'run') as run:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(PublicationRejected, 'E_PUBLISH_NATIVE_CUSTODY') as caught:
                native._execute_native('selected', 'withdraw', 'stage', 'dest', b'')
            self.assertIsInstance(caught.exception.__cause__, OSError)
            self.assertEqual(caught.exception.__cause__.errno, errno.EPERM)

        self.assert_closed(descriptors[0])

        observed = []

        def incomplete_sealing(fd, command, *args):

                # GET_SEALS result then lacks write and extent protection.
                return kernel_fcntl(fd, command, 1)

"""Host supervision of the HIA-emitted syscall-only native byte-ABI observer.

This is an explicit qualification transport, not a compiler, parser, production
activation or security sandbox. Each call execs a new sealed immutable ELF and
loads the supplied flat image RW-to-RX. Seed loading retains the independent
Python loader. The explicit linked format uses the separately built HIA policy
and system dynamic-loader bridge. Parent-owned
size-sealed shared output preserves real writes after native traps. No child is reused.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from contextlib import contextmanager
import fcntl
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PACKER = ROOT/'examples/hia_bootstrap/native_observer_packer.hepta'
LIMIT = 1 << 20
WORKSPACE_FIELDS = (0,8,16,24,40,48,56,64,72,80,88,96,104,112,224,248,1024)


def digest(data):
    return sha256(data).hexdigest()


def independent_reference():
    """VM executes the actual HIA ELF packer, before any B0 is generated."""
    from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import assemble_program
    from hepta.hia_program import execute_program
    from tools.generate_hia_native_observer import reference_image
    image = reference_image()
    from tools.hia_selfhost_bulk import Body
    observations = []
    # The Core ABI has a bounded return list. Observe disjoint windows from
    # fresh executions, covering EVERY byte without hashes standing for data.
    for begin in range(0,len(image),128):
        end = min(begin+128,len(image))
        body = Body(0); owners=[]; views=[]
        for count in (0,len(image),0):
            owner=body.value('buffer','buffer.new',[body.const('usize',count)])
            view=body.value('mutbuf','borrow.mut',[owner])
            owners.append(owner);views.append(view)
        body.effect('buffer.fill',[views[1],body.const('u8',165)])
        body.effect('loan.end',[views[0]])
        views[0]=body.value('readbuf','borrow.read',[owners[0]])
        result=body.value('u32','call',views,{'function':'f0'})
        values=[result]+[body.value('u8','buffer.load',[views[1],body.const('usize',at)])
                        for at in range(begin,end)]
        for view in views:body.effect('loan.end',[view])
        for owner in owners:body.effect('owner.drop',[owner])
        returns=','.join(['u32']+['u8']*(end-begin))
        wrapper=('hia-asm.v1 hepta.hia.program.v8 observer_reference\n'
            +'fn reference_entry() -> ('+returns+') effects(alloc,read,write,trap) entry(b0)\n'
            +'block b0()\n'+body.text()+'  ret('+','.join(values)+')\nend\n'
            +PACKER.read_text().split('\n',1)[1])
        checked=assemble_program(wrapper.encode())
        observed=execute_program(checked,'reference_entry',[])
        if observed.get('status')!='returned' or observed['values']!=[len(image),*image[begin:end]]:
            raise AssertionError('independent VM did not reproduce exact observer ELF window')
        observations.append({'begin':begin,'end':end,'vm_core_sha256':checked.sha256,'result':observed})
    return {'before_B0':True, 'packer_source_sha256':digest(PACKER.read_bytes()),
        'vm_windows':observations, 'expected_image_sha256':digest(image),
        'expected_image_bytes':len(image), 'every_output_byte_compared':True,
        'whole_stack_rewritten_in_hia':False, 'all_input_equivalence_proved':False}


def build(directory, compiler, reference):
    from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost import compile_stage, invoke
    directory = Path(directory)
    packer, compilation = compile_stage(directory, 'native-observer-packer', compiler, PACKER.read_bytes())
    execution, output = invoke(directory, 'native-observer-emit', packer, b'')
    size = reference['expected_image_bytes']
    if (execution.get('status') != 'returned' or execution.get('abi_status') != 0
            or execution.get('core_u32') != size or not execution.get('source_unchanged')
            or digest(output[:size]) != reference['expected_image_sha256']):
        raise AssertionError('HIA packer output differs from independent VM')
    executable = directory/'native-observer.elf'
    executable.write_bytes(output[:size])
    executable.chmod(0o700)
    receipt = {'compiler_sha256':digest(Path(compiler).read_bytes()),
        'source_sha256':digest(PACKER.read_bytes()), 'executable_sha256':digest(output[:size]),
        'independent_reference_before_B0':reference['before_B0'],
        'native_compilation':compilation, 'native_emission':execution,
        'production_activated':False, 'whole_stack_rewritten_in_hia':False}
    (directory/'native-observer-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
    return executable, receipt


def frame(image, source, capacity, workspace_size, workspace_fill, output_fd=None):
    if (not isinstance(image, bytes) or not 0 < len(image) <= 4*LIMIT
            or not isinstance(source, bytes) or len(source) > LIMIT
            or type(capacity) is not int or not 0 <= capacity <= LIMIT
            or type(workspace_size) is not int or not 0 <= workspace_size <= LIMIT
            or type(workspace_fill) is not int or not 0 <= workspace_fill <= 255
            or (output_fd is not None and (type(output_fd) is not int or not 3 <= output_fd <= 2147483647))):

    return b'HIAOBS02'+struct.pack('<6Q',len(image),len(source),capacity,workspace_size,workspace_fill,
        (1<<64)-1 if output_fd is None else output_fd)+image+source


def execute(executable_bytes, request, *, cwd, timeout=20, arguments=(), output_fd=None):
    """Exec exact sealed bytes, with binary stdin/stdout; never interpret them."""
    fd = os.memfd_create('hia-native-observer', os.MFD_ALLOW_SEALING)
    try:
        view = memoryview(executable_bytes)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            if written <= 0:
                raise OSError('short observer image write')
            view = view[written:]
        fcntl.fcntl(fd, getattr(fcntl,'F_ADD_SEALS',1033), 15)
        if fcntl.fcntl(fd, getattr(fcntl,'F_GET_SEALS',1034)) & 15 != 15:
            raise OSError('observer image sealing failed')

            cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout, pass_fds=(fd,) if output_fd is None else (fd,output_fd),
            env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LANG':'C.UTF-8','LC_ALL':'C.UTF-8','TZ':'UTC'})
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


@contextmanager
def shared_output(initial, enabled):
    if not enabled:
        yield None
        return
    descriptor=os.memfd_create('hia-native-output',os.MFD_ALLOW_SEALING)
    try:
        os.ftruncate(descriptor,max(1,len(initial)))

        while at<len(initial):
            written=os.pwrite(descriptor,initial[at:],at)
            if written<=0:raise OSError('short shared output preimage write')
            at+=written
        fcntl.fcntl(descriptor,getattr(fcntl,'F_ADD_SEALS',1033),7)
        if fcntl.fcntl(descriptor,getattr(fcntl,'F_GET_SEALS',1034)) & 7 != 7:
            raise OSError('shared output extent sealing failed')
        yield descriptor
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)

    return bytes(data)

            'capacity':capacity, 'workspace_size':workspace_size, 'workspace_fill':workspace_fill,
            'observer_sha256':digest(executable),'shared_output_fd':capture_fd,
            'observe_trap_writes':observe_trap_writes,'output_initial_sha256':digest(initial), 'frame_sha256':digest(payload),

"""Fresh-process, source-bound independent Core references, all before B0.

Only the fixed oracle inventory is admitted. Native compiler generations remain
sequential. Each worker fully verifies its ordinary Core VM inputs; no verified
program cache, changed deadline, native-child reuse or reference substitution.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if __package__ in {None, ""}:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from tools.hia_selfhost_contract import CONTRACT_PATH, file_digests, validate_contract

BUILDERS = {
    "exports": ("tools.qualify_hia_selfhost_exports", "independent_reference"),
    "names": ("tools.hia_selfhost_names", "independent_reference"),
    "cli": ("tools.qualify_hia_selfhost_cli", "independent_reference"),
    "explicit-traps": ("tools.hia_selfhost_traps", "independent_reference"),
    "resource": ("tools.hia_selfhost_resources", "independent_resource_reference"),
    "bulk": ("tools.hia_selfhost_bulk", "independent_bulk_reference"),
    "loan": ("tools.hia_selfhost_loans", "independent_loan_reference"),
    "cfg": ("tools.hia_selfhost_cfg_worklist", "independent_reference"),
    "capacity": ("tools.hia_selfhost_capacity", "independent_capacity_reference"),
    "tail": ("tools.hia_selfhost_tailcalls", "independent_tail_reference"),
    "select": ("tools.hia_selfhost_select", "independent_select_reference"),
    "effects": ("tools.hia_selfhost_effects", "independent_reference"),
    "multi": ("tools.hia_selfhost_multi_results", "independent_reference"),
    "keyword": ("tools.hia_selfhost_keywords", "independent_reference"),
    "signed": ("tools.hia_selfhost_signed_cases", "independent_reference"),
    "scalar-casts": ("tools.hia_selfhost_scalar_casts", "independent_reference"),
    "core": ("tools.qualify_hia_selfhost", "independent_call_reference"),
}
SCHEMA = "hepta.hia.selfhost-independent-reference-process.v1"


def digest(value):
    return sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()


def snapshot():
    return {**file_digests(), CONTRACT_PATH: sha256((ROOT / CONTRACT_PATH).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}


def validate_envelope(report, family, identity):
    if (type(report) is not dict or report.get("schema") != SCHEMA
            or report.get("family") != family or report.get("before_B0") is not True
            or report.get("source_manifest_sha256") != identity
            or type(report.get("worker_pid")) is not int or report["worker_pid"] <= 0
            or type(report.get("reference")) is not dict
            or report.get("reference_sha256") != digest(report["reference"])):
        raise ValueError("independent reference identity or payload mismatch")
    return report["reference"]


def produce(family):
    if family not in BUILDERS:
        raise ValueError("unknown independent reference family")
    validate_contract()
    identity = digest(snapshot())
    started = time.monotonic_ns()
    module, symbol = BUILDERS[family]
    builder = getattr(importlib.import_module(module), symbol)
    reference = (builder((ROOT / "examples/hia_bootstrap/bytesum.hepta").read_bytes())
                 if family == "core" else builder())
    validate_contract()
    if digest(snapshot()) != identity:
        raise ValueError("independent reference source changed during execution")
    return {"schema": SCHEMA, "family": family, "before_B0": True,
            "source_manifest_sha256": identity, "reference_sha256": digest(reference),
            "reference": reference, "worker_pid": os.getpid(),
            "wall_elapsed_ns": time.monotonic_ns() - started}


def _run(directory, family, identity):
    stem = directory / ("reference-" + family)
    output = stem.with_suffix(".worker.json")
    command = [sys.executable, "-I", "-S", "-B", str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
               "--family", family, "--output", str(output.resolve())]
    started = time.monotonic_ns()
    with stem.with_suffix(".stdout.log").open("xb") as out, stem.with_suffix(".stderr.log").open("xb") as err:
        with subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=directory, stdout=out, stderr=err) as child:
            returncode = child.wait()
            pid = child.pid
    receipt = {"family": family, "command": command, "worker_pid": pid,
               "returncode": returncode, "started_monotonic_ns": started,
               "completed_monotonic_ns": time.monotonic_ns()}
    if returncode:
        raise AssertionError({"independent_reference_process_failed": receipt})
    raw = output.read_bytes()
    report = json.loads(raw)
    result = validate_envelope(report, family, identity)
    if report["worker_pid"] != pid:
        raise ValueError("independent reference PID does not match fresh child")
    receipt.update({"report_sha256": sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                    "reference_sha256": report["reference_sha256"],
                    "source_manifest_sha256": identity})
    return family, result, receipt


def build_references(directory, manifest, filenames, workers):
    if type(workers) is not int or workers != 2:
        raise ValueError("reference scheduling uses the existing two-worker budget")
    if set(filenames) != set(BUILDERS) - {"core"}:
        raise ValueError("independent reference inventory mismatch")
    identity = digest(manifest)
    # Start expensive families first. A thread only owns a fresh subprocess;
    # VM globals and verified values are never shared between workers.
    # Retained remote artifact 13762513077 identifies names as the longest
    # fresh oracle, followed by signed/casts. Schedule long work first while
    # retaining every fresh worker, every VM check, and exactly two slots.
    priority = ("names", "signed", "scalar-casts", "keyword", "exports", "capacity")
    order = (*priority, *[f for f in BUILDERS if f not in priority])
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
        scheduled = [pool.submit(_run, directory, family, identity) for family in order]
        observations = [future.result() for future in scheduled]
    references = {family: result for family, result, receipt in observations}
    if digest(snapshot()) != identity:
        raise ValueError("reference source manifest changed before B0")
    for family, filename in {**filenames, "core": "independent-core-reference.json"}.items():
        with (directory / filename).open("x") as stream:
            json.dump(references[family], stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
            stream.write("\n")
    return references, [receipt for family, result, receipt in observations]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--family", choices=tuple(BUILDERS), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = produce(args.family)
    with args.output.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(result, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

COMPILER_SHA256 = 'HEPTA_HIA_COMPILE_RECEIPT_COMPILER_SHA256'
OBSERVATIONS = 'HEPTA_HIA_COMPILE_RECEIPT_OBSERVATIONS'
PAYLOAD = bytes.fromhex('b82a000000c39090')  # independent function: return 42


def digest(raw):
    return sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def machine_emitter(status=0):
    # Store a known eight-byte image, then return status:u32/length:u32.
    return (b'\x48\xb8' + PAYLOAD + b'\x48\x89\x02\x48\xb8'
            + struct.pack('<Q', (status << 32) | len(PAYLOAD)) + b'\xc3')


@unittest.skipUnless(sys.platform == 'linux' and platform.machine() == 'x86_64',
                     'actual compile byte-ABI controls require Linux x86-64')
class CompileReceiptNativeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        selected, expected = os.environ.get(COMPILER), os.environ.get(COMPILER_SHA256)
        if not selected or not expected or re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', expected) is None:
            raise AssertionError('supply an explicit retained compiler path and exact SHA256 for these native controls')
        cls.compiler = Path(selected).resolve(strict=True)
        cls.compiler_bytes = cls.compiler.read_bytes()
        if digest(cls.compiler_bytes) != expected:
            raise AssertionError('retained compile-receipt test compiler bytes differ')
        root = os.environ.get(OBSERVATIONS)
        if root:
            cls.directory = Path(root) / cls.__name__
            cls.directory.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True)
        else:
            cls.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hia-compile-receipt-')
            cls.addClassCleanup(cls.temporary.cleanup)
            cls.directory = Path(cls.temporary.name)
        # This fixture deliberately exercises the original disposable child.
        # Its seed, linked and flat return conventions are separate controls.
        original_child = patch.object(shared, 'NATIVE_OBSERVER', None)
        original_child.start()
        cls.addClassCleanup(original_child.stop)
        cls.source = b'independent byte-ABI emitter input; not HIA source'
        cls.fixture = cls.directory / 'independent-emitter.bin'
        cls.fixture.write_bytes(machine_emitter())
        cls.base_receipt, cls.base_output = shared.invoke(cls.directory, 'recorded-positive',
                                                        cls.fixture, cls.source)
        if cls.base_receipt.get('abi_status') != 0 or cls.base_output[:8] != PAYLOAD:
            raise AssertionError('independent actual byte-ABI fixture did not execute')
        cls.control_observations = []
        cls.tool_observations = []

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        unchanged = cls.compiler.read_bytes() == cls.compiler_bytes
        report = {'schema': 'hepta.hia.compile-receipt-test-observations.v1',
            'compiler_path': str(cls.compiler), 'compiler_sha256': digest(cls.compiler_bytes),
            'compiler_unchanged': unchanged, 'compiler_cold_qualification_performed': False,
            'controlled_transport_observations': cls.control_observations,
            'assembler_linker_observations': cls.tool_observations,
            'python': sys.version, 'public_return_schema_changed': False}
        (cls.directory / 'observations.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
        if not unchanged:
            raise AssertionError('retained compiler changed during native receipt controls')

    def test_actual_flat_success_preserves_existing_receipt_fields_and_bytes(self):
        recorded = []
        original = shared.invoke

        def observe(*args, **kwargs):
            result, output = original(*args, **kwargs)
            recorded.append(copy.deepcopy(result))
            return result, output

        with patch.object(shared, 'invoke', side_effect=observe):
            image, result = shared.compile_stage(self.directory, 'actual-flat-success',
                                                 self.fixture, self.source)
        self.assertEqual(image.read_bytes(), PAYLOAD)
        self.assertEqual(result['produced_bytes'], len(PAYLOAD))
        self.assertEqual(result['produced_sha256'], digest(PAYLOAD))
        previous = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                    if key not in {'produced_image', 'produced_bytes', 'produced_sha256'}}
        self.assertEqual(json.dumps(previous, sort_keys=True), json.dumps(recorded[0], sort_keys=True))
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((self.directory / 'actual-flat-success.receipt.json').read_bytes()), result)
        execution, output = shared.invoke(self.directory, 'actual-flat-produced-run', image, b'',
                                          capacity=1, workspace_size=1)
        self.assertEqual(execution['abi_status'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(execution['core_u32'], 42)
        self.assertEqual(output, b'\xa5')

    def test_actual_nonzero_status_with_correct_output_cannot_publish_an_image(self):
        failed = self.directory / 'independent-emitter-status-one.bin'
        failed.write_bytes(machine_emitter(status=1))
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            shared.compile_stage(self.directory, 'actual-status-one', failed, self.source)
        receipt = json.loads((self.directory / 'actual-status-one.receipt.json').read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(receipt['abi_status'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(receipt['result_u64'], (1 << 32) | len(PAYLOAD))
        self.assertEqual(receipt['core_u32'], len(PAYLOAD))
        self.assertEqual((self.directory / 'actual-status-one.output.bin').read_bytes()[:8], PAYLOAD)
        self.assertFalse((self.directory / 'actual-status-one.image.bin').exists())

    def test_original_seven_malformed_transport_cases_refuse_before_publication(self):
        # These values are substituted into a receipt obtained from the real
        # independent fixture. They are not claimed as real compiler returns.
        changes = (
            ('abi-status-false', {'abi_status': False}),
            ('abi-status-float-zero', {'abi_status': 0.0}),
            ('source-unchanged-integer', {'source_unchanged': 1}),
            ('forbidden-modules-false', {'forbidden_compiler_modules_loaded': False}),
            ('core-size-bool', {'core_u32': True}),
            ('result-mismatch', {'result_u64': 7}),
            ('wrong-return-encoding', {'return_encoding': 'packed-ABI-status-and-u32'}),
        )
        for label, changed in changes:
            with self.subTest(case=label):
                result = {**copy.deepcopy(self.base_receipt), **changed}
                with patch.object(shared, 'invoke', return_value=(result, self.base_output)) as invocation:
                    with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
                        shared.compile_stage(self.directory, label, self.fixture, self.source)
                invocation.assert_called_once()
                self.assertFalse((self.directory / (label + '.image.bin')).exists())
                self.assertFalse((self.directory / (label + '.receipt.json')).exists())
                self.control_observations.append({'case': label, 'rejected': True,
                    'scope': 'controlled transport substitution, not native compiler execution',
                    'receipt': result})

    def test_consumed_identities_complete_output_and_buffer_contract_are_bound(self):
        changes = (
            ('image-hash', {'image_sha256': 'a' * 64}),
            ('artifact-hash', {'artifact_sha256': 'b' * 64}),
            ('source-hash', {'source_sha256': 'c' * 64}),
            ('input-hash', {'input_sha256': 'd' * 64}),
            ('input-size-bool', {'input_bytes': True}),
            ('output-hash', {'output_sha256': 'e' * 64}),
            ('result-bool', {'result_u64': True}),
            ('wrong-format', {'format': 'seed-shared'}),
            ('output-capacity', {'limits': {**self.base_receipt['limits'], 'output_capacity': 8}}),
            ('workspace-capacity', {'limits': {**self.base_receipt['limits'], 'workspace_bytes': 0}}),
        )
        for label, changed in changes:
            with self.subTest(case=label):
                result = {**copy.deepcopy(self.base_receipt), **changed}
                with patch.object(shared, 'invoke', return_value=(result, self.base_output)):
                    with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
                        shared.compile_stage(self.directory, label, self.fixture, self.source)
                self.assertFalse((self.directory / (label + '.image.bin')).exists())
                self.control_observations.append({'case': label, 'rejected': True,
                    'scope': 'controlled transport substitution, not native compiler execution',
                    'receipt': result})
        shortened = self.base_output[:8]
        result = {**copy.deepcopy(self.base_receipt), 'output_sha256': digest(shortened)}
        with patch.object(shared, 'invoke', return_value=(result, shortened)):
            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
                shared.compile_stage(self.directory, 'truncated-full-buffer', self.fixture, self.source)
        self.assertFalse((self.directory / 'truncated-full-buffer.image.bin').exists())

    def test_seed_and_linked_return_conventions_remain_accepted(self):
        source = self.directory / 'independent-emitter.S'
        source.write_text('.text\n.globl f0\n.type f0,@function\nf0:\n.byte '
            + ','.join(str(byte) for byte in machine_emitter())
            + '\n.size f0,.-f0\n.section .note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits\n')
        obj, library = self.directory / 'independent-emitter.o', self.directory / 'independent-emitter.so'
        assembler, linker = shutil.which('as'), shutil.which('ld')
        self.assertIsNotNone(assembler)
        self.assertIsNotNone(linker)
        for command in ([assembler, '--64', str(source), '-o', str(obj)],
                        [linker, '-shared', '-z', 'defs', '-z', 'noexecstack', '--build-id=none', str(obj), '-o', str(library)]):
            before = Path(command[0]).read_bytes()
            completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
            self.tool_observations.append({'command': command, 'tool_sha256': digest(before),
                'returncode': completed.returncode, 'stdout': completed.stdout, 'stderr': completed.stderr,
                'tool_unchanged': Path(command[0]).read_bytes() == before})
            self.assertEqual(completed.returncode, 0, completed.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(Path(command[0]).read_bytes(), before)
        for image_format, encoding in [('seed-shared', 'packed-ABI-status-and-u32'),
                                       ('linked-selfhost', 'zero-extended-u32')]:
            with self.subTest(format=image_format):
                image, result = shared.compile_stage(self.directory, 'actual-' + image_format,
                    library, self.source, image_format=image_format)
                self.assertEqual(result['return_encoding'], encoding)
                self.assertEqual(result['result_u64'], len(PAYLOAD))
                self.assertEqual(image.read_bytes(), PAYLOAD)

    def test_real_retained_hia_compilation_and_generated_behavior(self):
        source = (ROOT / 'examples/hia_bootstrap/bytesum.hepta').read_bytes()
        image, result = shared.compile_stage(self.directory, 'actual-hia-bytesum', self.compiler, source)
        self.assertEqual(result['image_sha256'], digest(self.compiler_bytes))
        self.assertEqual(result['source_sha256'], digest(source))
        self.assertEqual(result['produced_sha256'], digest(image.read_bytes()))
        for index, data in enumerate((b'', b'receipt source binding', bytes(range(256)) * 4)):
            expected = 5381
            for byte in data:
                expected = ((expected * 33) ^ byte) & 0xffffffff
            execution, output = shared.invoke(self.directory, 'actual-hia-run-' + str(index),
                                              image, data, capacity=1, workspace_size=1)
            self.assertEqual(execution['abi_status'], 0)
            self.assertEqual(execution['core_u32'], expected)
            self.assertEqual(output, bytes([expected & 255]))
            self.assertIs(execution['source_unchanged'], True)
        self.assertEqual((ROOT / 'examples/hia_bootstrap/bytesum.hepta').read_bytes(), source)
